descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced Senior SAP ABAP Developer to join our team and contribute to the development, enhancement, and maintenance of SAP applications. The ideal candidate has strong technical expertise in SAP ABAP development, experience working with SAP environments, and the ability to deliver scalable and efficient solutions in complex enterprise landscapes.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain SAP applications using ABAP.
Develop and enhance custom SAP programs, reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Perform ABAP development, debugging, performance optimization, and troubleshooting.
Work with SAP modules and integrate solutions across different SAP systems.
Develop and maintain interfaces using IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and web services.
Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and other technical teams.
Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews.
Ensure code quality, performance, security, and compliance with SAP development standards.
Support testing, deployment, and production activities.
 Requirements 
Several years of professional experience in SAP ABAP development.
Strong knowledge of ABAP programming and object-oriented ABAP.
Experience with ABAP Reports, ALV, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, and Enhancements.
Good understanding of SAP architecture and data dictionary (DDIC).
Experience with SAP interfaces, including IDocs, RFCs, and web services.
Knowledge of SAP modules such as FI, CO, SD, MM, or other relevant modules.
Experience with debugging, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with SAP development tools and transport management.
Experience working in complex SAP environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Proficiency in English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP).
Experience with Core Data Services (CDS Views).
Knowledge of SAP Fiori and SAPUI5.
Experience with SAP Gateway and OData services.
Familiarity with SAP BTP and modern SAP development approaches.
Experience with SAP HANA database and performance optimization.
Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
